name: Couple mid — camera RIGHT of couple
image_prompt: ONE continuous tropical South Indian wedding pavilion, 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook. Cream carved stone arches/pillars, misty lake, temple gopuram, mountains, boat; banana leaves, jasmine+lotus, brass urulis, polished floor, soft morning light. No watermark. LOCKED: GROOM maroon half-sleeve shirt + white gold-border veshti + sandals; BRIDE rich green silk saree, heavy gold jewellery (necklace layers, jhumkas, maang tikka, oddiyanam, bangles), long bridal hair with jasmine+roses — NOT a bun. Couple STANDING still in place, holding hands, looking at each other affectionately. STRICT: NO walking, NO stepping forward, NO stride, feet planted. Camera moves around them — they do not walk. CAMERA: medium-wide INSIDE, camera positioned to the RIGHT of couple (couple left-of-center), slight three-quarter. No text.
